composite_insights.headline: You will feel tension earlier than most people, but you are less likely to bring it out through sustained expression.
composite_insights.mechanism: High emotional sensitivity allows stress, misunderstanding and uncertainty to enter the system earlier, while low extroversion makes it less likely that this load will be taken out through immediate expression, social release or high-frequency interaction. The result was not that it lost control on the spot, but that it seemed stable on the outside, but it had begun to operate at high load for a long time inside.
composite_insights.strengths: This combination will make you discover the cracks in the environment and relationships earlier than many people, and you will be less likely to blindly enter high-stimulation fields.
composite_insights.tradeoffs: The price is: you are more likely to enter a state of "thinking a lot but delaying entering, being busy internally but not seeing it from the outside".
composite_insights.context_boundary: This pattern is clearest in high-stimulation social settings, sustained collaboration, and limited recovery time; safe familiar one-to-one contact may soften it.
composite_insights.action_bridge: Your key issue is not to force yourself to be more outgoing, but to express your feelings earlier, express boundaries at a lower cost, and arrange recovery more proactively.

composite_insights.headline: Generating new ideas and bringing them into interaction are separate channels.
composite_insights.mechanism: Openness shapes the breadth of internal exploration, while extraversion shapes how quickly and frequently that material enters external conversation.
composite_insights.strengths: Separating exploration from expression explains both quiet depth and creativity that develops through speaking.
composite_insights.tradeoffs: Treating expression volume as idea volume can underestimate quiet exploration or overestimate the maturity of immediate expression.
composite_insights.context_boundary: This interaction is clearest in creative collaboration, public expression, and unfamiliar topics; it matters less in familiar independent work.
composite_insights.action_bridge: Choose an output format that fits your expression pace, then check whether others actually understood the idea.

composite_insights.headline: Your capacity to keep moving and the internal load you carry while doing so need to be read together.
composite_insights.mechanism: Conscientiousness shapes planning, persistence, and completion; emotionality shapes how strongly uncertainty, mistakes, and pressure register internally. The same output can carry very different recovery costs.
composite_insights.strengths: Reading execution and load together separates reliable performance from sustainable performance.
composite_insights.tradeoffs: Output alone can hide high-pressure maintenance, while stress reactions alone can hide structure that is already working.
composite_insights.context_boundary: This interaction is clearest around deadlines, ambiguous responsibility, and sustained load; it may recede under a controllable pace.
composite_insights.action_bridge: Track both the completion signal and the recovery cost, not output alone.
